Subject: Kelridge Bistro Group - Quote Request

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the submission on Kelridge Bistro Group! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

Just a few quick questions before I can finalize the quote:

- Can you confirm the primary cuisine type and any cooking operations that might present higher exposure (e.g., wood-fired ovens, deep fryers)?
- What are the current fire suppression and alarm systems in place?
- Are there any planned renovations or expansions in the next 12 months?
- Can you provide details on their liquor liability exposure (if applicable)?

Once I have these details, I'll work up competitive terms for you.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
